lastCompletedStory.title: Move auto-ship dispatch from runSupervisor to runSidecarLoop post-clearActive

nextStoryContext: US-001 (ADR 0013) moved the auto-ship decision out of runSupervisor entirely: RunSupervisorOptions.autoShipFn is gone, and runSupervisor's 'complete' branch no longer writes the autoShipDispatchedAt marker. The gated decision (result.status==='complete' && prd.review.lastVerdict==='CLEAN' && marker undefined) now lives in runSidecarLoop, positioned AFTER opts.clearActive() and right before the existing flipActiveFn auto-chain block, using supervisorOpts.readPrd()/writePrd()/clock() (the SAME RunSupervisorOptions bag returned by opts.buildOpts(), read again after runSupervisorFn returns) rather than a new RunSidecarLoopOptions field. RunSidecarLoopOptions.autoShipFn is unchanged in shape and is still wired the same way from sidecar.ts (makeAutoShipFn -> makeSetPhaseFn('shipping')); only the CALLSITE moved. teardownWorkerPaneFn (CAM-188) still runs INSIDE runSupervisor's finishTerminal, so the new ordering invariant is teardown (inner) THEN auto-ship (outer), the opposite of the old CAM-181 order -- see the rewritten test in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts. US-002 (next story, per prd.json) is a real-writer regression test asserting phase:shipping survives the terminal teardown chain end-to-end (makeSetPhaseFn + makeClearActive + a real onProgress) -- it should exercise the ACTUAL production closures, not fakes, per the CAM-191 story notes gotcha that prior fakes never caught this bug class.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal control-flow refactor across loop.ts/sidecar.ts (state-file write ordering); no external library API surface touched.
